Mushrooms Blockade.scenario: You step into a clearing of towering mushrooms. Their glowing caps slowly swivel, tracking your every movement.

best: The mushrooms were impressed with how in sync you were, they created a large opening for the fastest route
neutral: While successful, the mushrooms were persistent on not letting you through, causing you to waste a lot of time as well as making you feel quite sore
worst: The mushrooms felt no desire to let you through, and found you quite laughable

The Annual Snail Parade.scenario: You stumble into the 14th Annual Snail Procession. Tiny banners wave as the snails march with serious determination.

worst: The snails truly appreciated this but the parade was far from fast. You wasted a lot of time. So much for being respectful.
best: The snails were very angry but there's only so much they could do. You managed to zoom by and caused no harm, only an angry, but slow, mob of snails
neutral: This was not the fastest option but with you joining the parade the snails felt a sense of invigoration. They moved faster and the parade went by quicker, but not by that much

Floral Grasp.scenario: You enter a field of delicate flowers. Their stems gently curl around your ankles, tightening just enough to anchor you in place

The Wolf Guardian.scenario: A giant armored wolf holding a massive sword steps forward and blocks your path.

The Angry Shroombear.scenario: A massive bear rears up before you, claws flashing in the moonlight.

The Mirror-Image Duel.scenario: You reach a crystal-clear pond where your reflection climbs out, intent on taking your place in the real world.

The Merchant.scenario: Gilbert the frog in a tiny coat sits behind a crooked wooden stall. 'Greetings, travelers... care to improve your survival odds? I have a few items available.'

option 1: Gain extra time on one future decision
option 3: Reveals which option is safest in a future scenario

Fairy Fountain.scenario: Magical forest fairies greet you before a glowing fountain, offering a blessing for finding their hidden sanctuary.

option 1: Heals you of all your ailments
option 2: Reveal the worst option on a decision

The Gardener.scenario: Tobias the forest florist tends to his magical flowers and offers you one hiding a mysterious reward.

option 1: Heals you of all your ailments

The Statue of the Greedy King.scenario: A golden statue blocks the path, its mouth open. It will only move if it 'tastes' something incredibly valuable

option 1: Lose the ability to choose answer one
option 2: Lose the ability to choose answer three
option 3: Lose the ability to choose answer two

The Glowing Bridge.scenario: A narrow bridge made of shimmering blue light stretches over a bottomless ravine, its glow flickering unpredictably.

option 1: Drop your items to reduce weight

The Illuminated Portal.scenario: A mesmerizing portal hums in the woods, pulling at your mind. You cannot look away unless you please it.

The Goblin Interns.scenario: Three goblins in oversized business suits hand out aggressively professional flyers.

worst: Take a flyer and encourage them
neutral: Listen to their long sales pitch

The Sad Cheese Seller.scenario: A tiny mouse chef sits behind a lonely cheese cart. 'No one believes in artisinal forest cheese anymore...'

The Whimsical Tree.scenario: An ancient and mythical tree blocks your path. 'Answer my riddle,' it booms. 'I am always hungry, I must be fed. The finger I touch soon turns red.

Trapped Ogre.scenario: An ogre has fallen into a deep pit. 'HEY... little help here?' A glowing potion rests just outside the hole.

Abandoned Cart.scenario: A gnome's cart sits against a tree, a goblin is taking items from it and ushers you to help while the gnome doesn't notice.

helpful: Yell to the gnome and warn him
selfish: Raid the cart with the goblin

Witch's Soup.scenario: A witch stirs a bubbling pond of tadpoles. She claims she means no harm, they're only for soup.
